en: Three rivers meet under the town and go over the falls together. The fishing's never dull.
But the big ones sit at the bottom of the pool under the falls. You need a proper rod for those.
I've worn out more rods than I can count. This one's still good, though. Take it.
That's a Super Rod. Whatever's down there, you'll meet it now.
The falls carry everything down to Couriway sooner or later. Even the Pokémon.
